repo_notes.content: Local benchmark suite for LLMs (German project, English code). Goal: realistic scores on local hardware with ~16 GB VRAM (RTX 5070 Ti) - finds the Pareto frontier of parameter count, GGUF quantization and KV-cache/context settings. Since v13.0.6 all Python modules live in src/ (run_benchmarks.py, registry_tool.py, assemble_blueprint.py, benchmark_config.py, model_manager.py, consolidate_results.py ...); the code base root and src/ are canonical - do NOT document root-level scripts/files (they are archived legacy).
repo_notes.author: pskraemer11

repo_notes.content: Configuration is data-driven and lives in doc-git/: model_registry.yaml (canonical per-model data: quants, arch, template, context, offload, blueprint, reasoning), Blueprint-Definitions in blueprint_definitions.yaml, chat templates in doc-git/Jinja-Chat-Templates/. registry_tool.py commands sync/compare/validate/rm are the main entrypoints; assemble_blueprint.py classifies registry models into blueprint categories and assembles system prompts.
repo_notes.author: pskraemer11

repo_notes.content: Key workflow (documented in doc-git/HowTo-Install-and-Configure-New-LLM_en.md): lms ls -> sync_model_configs.ps1 or registry_tool.py sync -> registry_tool.py sync internally runs classify+assemble+validate. New models are auto-detected; BLACKLIST models (embedding/ocr/vision/whisper/etc.) are skipped automatically.
repo_notes.author: pskraemer11

repo_notes.content: v13.0.10 features to document: YAML run-spec (--run-spec run.yaml, SUPPRESS probe parser, CLI>YAML>defaults precedence), seed flag, agentic-safety mode (--agentic-mode safety), structure gate (output_status, entry_point_found, extracted_code), gpt-oss reasoning centralization (GPTOSS_REASONING_EFFORT/GPTOSS_REASONING_BUDGET drive engine config AND gptoss_reasoning blueprint synchronously), Bonsai temperature overrides.
repo_notes.author: pskraemer11

repo_notes.content: Testing: unit/integration tests live under tests/ or test/ dirs (invocation: python -m pytest); run the full registry + benchmark pipeline via src/registry_tool.py validate before committing registry changes.
repo_notes.author: pskraemer11

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Project purpose: realistic local LLM benchmarking under 16 GB VRAM constraints (RTX 5070 Ti), Pareto frontier of parameter count / quantization / KV-cache. Summarize the 4 pipelines (Custom, EvalPlus, LM-Eval, Agentic) and the benchmarks (DS1000, CoderEval, HumanEval+, MBPP+, ARC, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, MATH-500, Tool-Eval).

pages.title: Getting Started & Installation
pages.purpose: Clone (github.com/pskraemer11/Local-LLM-Benchmark-Tool), prerequisites (LM Studio >=1.4.1 with REST/OpenAI API on localhost:1234, lms CLI, Python 3.13+), pip installs incl. lm-eval/env dependencies, first run of a small benchmark on a local model.

pages.title: Source Layout (src/)
pages.purpose: Directory structure after the v13.0.6 src/-migration: describe every Python module in src/ and its responsibility (launcher, registry tool, blueprint assembly, config, model manager, result consolidation, csv writer, benchmark runners, utils). Explicitly state that root-level scripts are archived legacy and must not be documented.

pages.title: Model Registry & Registration
pages.purpose: doc-git/model_registry.yaml schema and fields (quants, arch, template, context length, offload, num_parallel, reasoning, blueprint). registry_tool.py commands sync, validate, rm, configs and the HowIs/auto-add path via sync_model_configs.ps1. Explain BLACKLIST (embedding/ocr/vision) handling and that config JSONs live under user-concrete-model-default-config.

pages.title: Blueprints & System Prompts
pages.purpose: Blueprint system: blueprint definitions (reasoning_assistant, coding_agent, etc.), how assemble_blueprint.py classifies a model (Legacy/LLM reasoning families, arch info from GGUF headers) and injects system prompts into LM Studio configs. Document source of prompt templates.

pages.title: Benchmark Pipelines
pages.purpose: The 4 execution pipelines: Custom (Automatted sandbox exec with extracted code + tests), EvalPlus (differential testing, HumanEval+, MBPP+), LM-Stack/API (ARC, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, MATH-500 via generate_until), Agentic (tool-eval-bench). List the corresponding src/ modules and how they are launched.

pages.title: YAML Run-Spec & CLI
pages.purpose: The YAML run-spec (src/benchmark_run_stats.yaml) and main CLI: run-benchmark args, run.yaml, seed flag for reproducibility, SUPPRESS probe parser (CLI flags > YAML > defaults), single-instance lock. Show example invocation.

pages.title: Reasoning & Thinking Mode
pages.purpose: How reasoning models (thinking mode) are handled: thinking/reasoning fields in registry, enable_thinking flag, gpt-oss reasoning effort/budget centralization, reasoning patterns. Including agentic-safety mode.

pages.title: VRAM & Hardware Optimization
pages.purpose: The VRAM math: USABLE_VRAM_GB, num_parallel slot computation, enableUnifiedKvCache decision, k/v cache quantization, offratio. 16 GB target and what happens if exceeded. Reference the document section and registry fields.

pages.title: Testing & CI
pages.purpose: Unit test coverage for the core modules (registry_tool, benchmark config, assemble_blueprint), test commands, and integration tests for the pipelines. How to run the test suite before committing.
